steps.caption: Open Capture in the sidebar. This is where everything you hear, read or receive comes in.
The Capture dashboard: type a note, record a voice note, upload a card or document, upload a spreadsheet, pending reviews and history.
Choose Type — write or paste a note.
Write what happened in plain words, like a message to yourself.
More options lets you set when it happened and the language. Defaults are fine.
Press Save capture.
The review page. 'rule extractor' means practice mode: rules, not AI, read the note.
The Receipt says, in plain words, what CRE OS did with your note.
Saved: the note itself, with the items it understood.
Matched: 'Anil' is probably Anil Deshmukh — a medium-confidence match, so it waits for you to confirm.
Kharadi fits several buildings, so they are only suggestions — nothing is linked.
Questioned: 'Budget is 85' has no unit, so CRE OS asks one question instead of guessing.
Scheduled: 'Send options Friday' became a task due this Friday.
What the note is about: a new property requirement, a meeting note and a follow-up task.
Extracted information: each item with the exact words it came from.
Area: '20,000 feet' → 20,000 sq ft, an estimate. Carpet or chargeable is unknown, and stays unknown.
Budget: 85, but unit, pricing basis and CAM are unknown — not assumed.
'By September' is an informal target; the year is left unknown.
Here is the one question: does 85 mean ₹85 per sq ft per month, and is CAM extra?
Pick the answer you heard: ₹85 per sq ft per month, CAM extra.
Save answers.
Who and where: Anil → Anil Deshmukh. No company was named, so his only current employer is used — and flagged.
This list is everything that will be added when you press Reviewed. Nothing is saved to records yet.
Press Reviewed — add to records.
Requirement facts become proposals for approval — CRE OS never changes a requirement by itself.
The task 'Send options to Anil' is due Friday. It is also on your Tasks page.
